description: Combines PDFs into one, in the order given. The result is named after the first file, with -merged. Writes the result as a new file next to the input (or to output_path) and never replaces an existing file; the input is left unchanged.

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the new PDF, ending in .pdf. It must not exist yet. By default the result goes next to the input.

paths.description: Absolute paths of the PDFs to combine, in order

name: merge_pdfs

output_path.description: Where the new PDF was written

title: Merge PDFs
